purpose: R110-A stack input, ten preplanned paired windows; no pooling older windows. r109 low
segment_order: a b b a b a a b
production: Stock C; guarded disposable namespace per window, no installation; all before/after health, boot, config, mounts and identity checks and cleanup must pass.
analysis: Aggregate four equal-size segments per side/lane before taking one ratio per window. Exact order-statistic median intervals, 12 comparisons Bonferroni family >=95% coverage; no pooling initial screen. Independent identically distributed block ratio assumptions remain explicit.
decision: Apply corrected R110-A design plan: any lane with all ten daemon ratios positive triggers diagnosis, no guessing source variants. Mixed signs do not prove equivalence; disclose intervals and any systematic regression. Memory/correctness remain independent gates.
failure_rule: Stop on any collection, correctness, identity, health or cleanup failure and retain failed window. First window also validates new paired tool; if tool changes discard series and freeze new identities/order before restart.
execution_rule: Proceed after memory collection and correctness. If memory rejects, these CPU windows may characterize the rejected design but cannot override memory rejection. Never change source between windows.
